inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped MySQL report left-joins an inventory link table to location and catalog dimensions, then uses COUNT(DISTINCT ...) and HAVING to retain cities represented by multiple libraries.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a media lending coverage report. Library branches are left-joined to lending links and media titles, distinct branch and title counts are grouped by city, and HAVING keeps cities represented by at least two active branches. The source schema, rows, identifiers, and library domain are newly authored.

fixture_notes: Metro has two branches and three distinct titles with duplicate lending links; Harbor has one branch and is excluded; Rural has a branch with no lending links and is excluded by the distinct active-branch threshold.
determinism_notes: Branch IDs, title IDs, lending links, city names, threshold, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE media_titles (title_id INT PRIMARY KEY, title_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE lending_links (title_id INT NOT NULL, branch_id INT NOT NULL, copies INT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (title_id, branch_id))
CREATE TABLE library_branches (branch_id INT PRIMARY KEY, branch_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, city_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO media_titles VALUES (101, 'Aurora Signal'), (102, 'Copper Trail'), (103, 'Night Garden'), (104, 'Quiet Harbor')
INSERT INTO library_branches VALUES (1, 'Metro Central', 'Metro'), (2, 'Metro East', 'Metro'), (3, 'Harbor Desk', 'Harbor'), (4, 'Rural Shelf', 'Rural')

steps.sql: SELECT b.city_name, COUNT(DISTINCT b.branch_id) AS active_branch_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.title_id) AS distinct_title_count, SUM(COALESCE(l.copies, 0)) AS listed_copies FROM library_branches AS b LEFT JOIN lending_links AS l ON l.branch_id = b.branch_id LEFT JOIN media_titles AS t ON t.title_id = l.title_id GROUP BY b.city_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.branch_id) >= 2 ORDER BY b.city_name

checks.sql: SELECT branch_id, branch_name, city_name FROM library_branches ORDER BY branch_id
SELECT title_id, branch_id, copies FROM lending_links ORDER BY title_id, branch_id

SELECT b.city_name, COUNT(DISTINCT b.branch_id) AS active_branch_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.title_id) AS distinct_title_count, SUM(COALESCE(l.copies, 0)) AS listed_copies FROM library_branches AS b LEFT JOIN lending_links AS l ON l.branch_id = b.branch_id LEFT JOIN media_titles AS t ON t.title_id = l.title_id GROUP BY b.city_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.branch_id) >= 2 ORDER BY b.city_name
